VALIDATION_FAILED: Some data is not valid. Check the highlighted fields and try again.
INVALID_CURSOR: The list changed while you were browsing. Go back to the first page.
INVALID_SORT: The list cannot be sorted that way.
INVALID_FILTER: One of the filters is not valid. Check it and try again.
RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND: We could not find what you are looking for. It may have been removed or you may not have access.
METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: This action is not available. Catalog items are never deleted: you can archive them.
CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT: Someone else or another tab changed this record at the same time. Reload and try again.
IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS: Your previous request is still being processed. Please wait a moment.
PRECONDITION_FAILED: This record changed since you opened it. Reload to see the current version before saving.
PRECONDITION_REQUIRED: We could not verify the record version. Reload the page and try again.
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED: We could not record the operation safely. Please try again.
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This operation was already sent with different data. Reopen the form and submit it again.
REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND: One of the selected items no longer exists in this workspace.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests in a row. Wait a few seconds and try again.
INTERNAL_ERROR: An unexpected error occurred. If it happens again, share the request code with support.
SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is not available right now. Try again in a few seconds.
UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
WORKSPACE_ACCESS_DENIED: You are not an active member of this workspace.
INSUFFICIENT_ROLE: Your role does not allow this action.
INVALID_TIMEZONE: The time zone is not valid. Choose one from the list.
WORKSPACE_PENDING_DELETION: This workspace is being deleted and is read-only.
LAST_OWNER_CANNOT_LEAVE: There must be at least one owner. Assign another one before leaving.
DEMO_WORKSPACE_ALREADY_EXISTS: You already have a demo workspace. Clean it up before loading another one.
WORKSPACE_NOT_DEMO: This workspace is not a demo workspace: its data cannot be cleaned up.
DEMO_DATA_DISABLED: Loading demo data is disabled in this environment.
MONEY_INVALID_AMOUNT: The amount is not valid. Use only digits and a decimal point.
AMOUNT_SCALE_EXCEEDED: The amount has more decimals than the currency allows.
AMOUNT_NOT_POSITIVE: The amount must be greater than zero.
CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The currency does not match the account currency.
LEDGER_UNBALANCED_ENTRY: We could not record the entry because it does not balance. Let us know if it happens again.
LEDGER_ENTRY_TOO_FEW_POSTINGS: We could not record the accounting entry. Let us know if it happens again.
LEDGER_ZERO_AMOUNT_POSTING: We could not record an accounting posting with a zero amount.
LEDGER_SPLIT_REQUIRED: We could not link the accounting posting to its detail. Let us know if it happens again.
PERIOD_CLOSED: The month of that date is closed. Choose a date in an open period.
ACCOUNT_ARCHIVED: The account is archived and does not accept transactions.
ACCOUNT_CLOSED: The account is closed and does not accept transactions.
ACCOUNT_BALANCE_NOT_ZERO: The account balance must be zero to close it.
ACCOUNT_CURRENCY_IMMUTABLE: The currency of an account with transactions cannot change.
ACCOUNT_CURRENCY_KIND_MISMATCH: That currency is not allowed for this account type.
ACCOUNT_NAME_TAKEN: You already have an active account with that name.
SPLITS_DO_NOT_SUM: The parts do not add up to the total amount.
INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION: The transaction cannot move to that status.
TRANSACTION_RECONCILED: The transaction is reconciled. Unreconcile it before editing.
REFUND_EXCEEDS_ORIGINAL: The refund exceeds what remains to be refunded from the original expense.
TRANSFER_SAME_ACCOUNT: Source and destination accounts must be different.
TRANSFER_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The accounts use different currencies. Record a conversion instead.
CONVERSION_SAME_CURRENCY: Both accounts use the same currency. Record a transfer instead.
CONVERSION_AMOUNTS_INCONSISTENT: The conversion amounts and fees do not add up.
CATEGORY_ARCHIVED: The category is archived. Choose another one.
TAG_ARCHIVED: The tag is archived. Choose another one.
COUNTERPARTY_ARCHIVED: The counterparty is archived. Choose another one.
CATEGORY_KIND_MISMATCH: The category does not match the transaction type.
CATEGORY_DEPTH_EXCEEDED: No more subcategory levels can be created.
CATEGORY_GROUP_NOT_EMPTY: The group has active categories. Move or archive them first.
SYSTEM_CATEGORY_IMMUTABLE: System categories cannot be changed or archived.
COUNTERPARTY_ALIAS_TAKEN: That alias already belongs to another counterparty.
NAME_TAKEN: An active item with that name already exists.
FX_RATE_NOT_FOUND: There is no exchange rate for that currency and date. Record it first.
FX_RATE_ALREADY_SUPERSEDED: That exchange rate was already superseded.
FX_RATE_ANOMALY_ALREADY_REVIEWED: That exchange rate anomaly was already reviewed.
FX_RATE_NOT_ANOMALOUS: That exchange rate is not flagged as anomalous.
CURRENCY_NOT_ENABLED: That currency is not enabled in this workspace.
PERIOD_NOT_STARTED: That period has not started yet in the workspace time zone. You can activate it from its start date.
